labels: The standing figure places weight on a straight left leg while the right knee relaxes, producing opposing slopes through the hips and shoulders.; 선 인물이 곧은 왼다리로 체중을 받치고 오른 무릎을 풀어 골반과 어깨의 기울기가 서로 대응한다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The standing figure places weight on a straight left leg while the right knee relaxes, producing opposing slopes through the hips and shoulders.
